name: minddy-mobile
description: The minddy mobile shell: a native app around the minddy web app

scripts.test:ios: mkdir -p ios/DerivedData && swiftc ios/App/App/ServerStore.swift ios/App/App/UniversalLink.swift ios/Tests/main.swift -o ios/DerivedData/shell-logic-tests && ios/DerivedData/shell-logic-tests
scripts.sync: npm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.build:ios: npm run sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
